question: The human eye is like a camera. Its lens system forms an image on a light sensitive screen called the ______.
solution:
The correct answer is __**retina**__.__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• The human eye is like a camera. Its lens system forms an image on a light-sensitive screen called the Retina.
 
• The retina is the light-sensitive surface of an eye on which the image is formed.
 
 
• It generates signals which are transmitted to the brain through optical nerves
